b:
The climate has not changed,
the wind has not run out,
no comet has fallen,
the sky has not failed us

But life
has failed us
again

No firebombs rain down,
no volcanoes erupt,
no tsunamis rise,
no whirlwinds blow

But the wails of death,
again

No terrorism,
no soldiers' revolts,
no Nazis on the march,
no wars between nations

But in prisons at home,
again

The events may change,
yet history, again
